0.name: TEXT_FESNYRSEASHOGUN2014_00147_REDGENERAL_000_000
0.description: Heavensturn is a chance anew, yes? I am thinking it is like the game─rock, silk, claw.

1.name: TEXT_FESNYRSEASHOGUN2014_00147_REDGENERAL_000_001
1.description: The hand is coming up, the hand is making shapes, the hand is winning, losing, or tying. Every Heavensturn, the hand is coming up. Chance, <hex:020813E905FF076D276C616479FF076D276C6F726403>, chance.

2.name: TEXT_FESNYRSEASHOGUN2014_00147_REDGENERAL_000_010
2.description: You are losing the crimson uma kabuto? Sometimes, I am thinking you are not very smart.

3.name: TEXT_FESNYRSEASHOGUN2014_00147_REDGENERAL_000_011
3.description: Does <hex:020813E905FF076D276C616479FF076D276C6F726403> sniffle? Another one in your hands, I am thinking, will dry those tears.
